description:
Addresses findings from the /review on the Phase 2 kernel branch
(review/octo-z1d, commits 20d3e4c..fbd7ca0). Each child ticket is
scoped to a focused fix or small bundle; all are non-blocking polish
but we want them landed before Phase 3 (octo-t58) builds on the
kernel.

Children cover:
  - Correctness gaps in the abort path (duplicate aborted-assistant
    synthesis, missing session:stop telemetry on abnormal exit)
  - Small defensive hardening (nil stream accumulator, dead-pid
    guard, redundant drain_steering round-trip)
  - Doc refresh (stale moduledoc scope references in Session/Loop)
  - agent.demo Process-dict cleanup
  - Telemetry metadata noise reduction
  - Tool dispatch max_concurrency cap
  - Test coverage gaps (queue-full at facade, set_queue_mode
    steering, abort-during-LLM-stream)
title: [EPIC] Kernel review cleanup (Phase 2 review findings)
